rule: Outcome vocabulary: answer, enforced, denied, ratelimit, missing. A name not listed in outcomes is 'missing'. expected.callable is the first name a chat call confirmed, in roster order with system.ai first; null when none was confirmed. expected.blocked is true only when the run cannot start: no confirmed name and a refusal, not a rate limit. expected.steps are the admin steps a stop prints, with <principal> for the App's service principal.

texts.enforced: [INTERNAL_ERROR] Remote session creation failed: PERMISSION_DENIED: PERMISSION_DENIED: Querying pay-per-token foundation model endpoint '{name}' is disabled for this workspace. Please use Unity Gateway.
texts.denied: [INTERNAL_ERROR] PERMISSION_DENIED: User does not have CAN_QUERY on serving endpoint '{name}'.
texts.ratelimit: [REQUEST_LIMIT_EXCEEDED] Too many requests: rate limit exceeded on '{name}' (429).

worlds.description: Databricks-hosted endpoints answer; no Unity Gateway model services; no gateway route.
Enforce Unity Gateway: pay-per-token names refused with the enforcement text; system.ai model services answer on ai_query and the Unity Gateway chat route.
No serving endpoints; the Unity Gateway Codex route lists one chat model.
No chat model anywhere: no serving endpoint and no gateway model.

steps: Serve a chat model the App can use: a Databricks-hosted model, a provisioned throughput endpoint, or a Unity Gateway route.
Then grant <principal> CAN_QUERY on that endpoint, or EXECUTE on its system.ai model service with USE CATALOG on system and USE SCHEMA on system.ai.

worlds.description: Every call refused with PERMISSION_DENIED for the run identity (not the enforcement text).

steps: Grant <principal> CAN_QUERY on the chat model endpoints in Serving, or EXECUTE on their system.ai model services with USE CATALOG on system and USE SCHEMA on system.ai.

worlds.description: Every call answers 429 RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED (rate limit 0). Nothing can be confirmed, nothing is refused.
